Rename only the independent design translation unit to kernel.cpp; arithmetic, ports, checker and estimates remain identical. F16 fails compilation: this installed utils/x_hls_utils.h exposes fp_struct globally, and unary-minus ap_int<11> returns ap_int<12>, making a conditional with ap_int<11> ambiguous. Use the actual SDK symbol and explicit sign/magnitude branches. This is a source-typing fix with the same paper estimates and exact arithmetic. Exhaust all1024 raw values across three orderings, including zero,-512,511 and negative fractions, comparing binary float bits to ordinary division. Use ordinary conversion/division as the isolated control.
